alt: 兩名守衛攔住帶著贓物與火把的成年人，後方多間村屋焦黑冒煙，失去住所的居民抱著少量家當站在安全處。
scene_prompt: A non-graphic fictional story scene of a seriously destructive adult criminal being stopped by two uniformed community guards. The criminal has a dropped smoldering torch beside a stolen bulging coin sack; behind are several deliberately burned small village homes, with scorched doorways and smoke but no people inside, and displaced families clutching a few belongings at a safe distance. Show the widespread severe harm and stern accountability, no blood, no injury detail, no guns, no comic mischievous child.
